s.p.everywhere.c_link_copied: Li-link li koahetsoe: kenya ho SMS kapa WhatsApp.
s.p.everywhere.c_link_txt: Kopa lenane le e romelle ho: {u}
s.p.everywhere.c_how: Ho ngola ho bula ka Mehala, le ho fetolela: motho ka mong o bua puo ea hae, e 'ngoe e bala' me e utloa ho fetoleloa. Ka mor'a moo, u tla khutla mona.
s.p.everywhere.out_sp_on: 🔊 Ka mohlala, motho e mong le e mong o ka ngola mantsoe a mang.
s.p.everywhere.out_ea_on: 🎧 Earbuds: motho oa 1 o bala seo motho oa 2 a se buang ka earbuds ea hae. Motho oa 2 o bala phetolelo ea bona holimo.
s.p.everywhere.hands_on: Hands-free: ka mor'a mantsoe ohle, mic e bula ka eona bakeng sa motho e mong. Tobetsa microphone e khanyang ho emisa.
s.p.everywhere.hands_pause: Hands-free e khutlile (ha ho utloahale letho). Tobetsa mic ho tsoelapele.
s.p.everywhere.nothing_replay: Ha ho letho le ka etsoang hape.
s.p.everywhere.set_out_sp_d: Litšoantšo tse peli li ka fetoloa ka ho feletseng.
s.p.everywhere.set_out_ea_d: U na le li-earbuds tse rekiloeng mabenkeleng, tse neng li hokahantsoe le mohala ka Bluetooth. U bua le motho e mong mme o bala seo a se buang skrineng.
s.p.everywhere.set_hands: Hands-free (mikrofono e ea ho motho e mong ka eona)
s.p.everywhere.voice_auto: Ka boiketsetso (boits'oaro bo tloaelehileng ka ho fetisisa ba mohala)
s.p.everywhere.voice_none: Ha ho na molumo o fumanehang mohala ona bakeng sa puo ena: molumo oa default o tla sebelisoa.
s.p.everywhere.bt_note: Earbuds: mofuta ofe kapa ofe oa Bluetooth o rekisoang. Kopanya likhetho tsa Bluetooth tsa Android, ebe u tobetsa "Try": molumo o lokela ho tsoa ka har'a earbuds. Ts'ebeliso ha e khetha tlhahiso ea eona le ho laola li-buttons tsa earbud. Mic efe e sebelisoang (thelefono kapa earbuds) e itšetlehile ka Android.
s.p.voyage.title: Ho tsamaea
s.p.voyage.sub: E-ba le khotsofalo ea ho tsamaea le ho etsa hore u utloisisoe.
s.p.voyage.st_builtin: ✅ Sehlooho se ka hare: e fumaneha le ntle le marang-rang.
s.p.voyage.st_ready: ✅ {n} lihlooho tse hlophisitsoeng ka {d}: e fumaneha offline.
s.p.voyage.st_partial: ⚠️ {n} ea {t} mantsoe a hlophisitsoe. Qetellong ea ho hlophisa ka Internet.
s.p.voyage.st_none: Litlhaku tse seng li fumaneha ntle le marang-rang bakeng sa puo ena.
s.p.voyage.prep_note: Ho fetolela ka kotloloho (tšebeletso ea MyMemory e mahala), e hlahisoang ka nako e le 'ngoe ebe e bolokiloe mohala ona. Check important information.
s.p.voyage.e_offline: Ha ho hokahano: ho hlophisa ho hloka Internet. Tseba hape ha u hokahane.
s.p.voyage.e_quota: Lipheo tsa letsatsi le leng le le leng tsa ts'ebeletso ea ho fetolela li fihlile: {n} mantsoe a bolokiloe. ^Tsela hape mantsiboea.
s.p.voyage.e_other: Ho hlophisoa ho khutlile ({m}): {n} lihlooho li bolokiloe. Tsamaea hape.
s.p.voyage.step2: Litlhaku tse fumanehang ntle le marang-rang
s.p.voyage.step4: {l} ka lipuo tsa ka tse ratoang
s.p.voyage.fav_done: E kentsoeng ho likhetho tsa hau.
s.p.voyage.no_voice: Mohala ona ha o na lentsoe bakeng sa puo ena: mongolo o ka bonts'oa ("Show" button).
s.p.voyage.talk_d: Lipuisano tse ka lehlakoreng le leng, puo ea naha e se e hlophisitsoe
s.p.voyage.low_ok: E sebetsa kantle ho marang-rang: litlhaloso tse hahelletsoeng le tse hlophisitsoeng, konopo ea "Show", likhetho tsa hau.
s.p.voyage.low_partial: E itšetlehile ka mohala: molumo (“Litefeloa”) o sebetsa ntle le marang-rang feela haeba molumo o kenngoa ho mohala.
s.p.voyage.low_no: E hloka Internet: ho fetolela mantsoe a macha, mic (ho utloisisa puo), ho ikopanya ka Messaging.
s.p.voyage.found0: Ha ho letho le lumellanang le “{q}”. Tseba lentsoe le leng.
s.p.voyage.fav_off: Ho eketsa ho lihlooho tse ratoang: {p}
s.p.voyage.fav_none: Ha ho na mantsoe a ratoang. Tobetsa ☆ ka lehlakoreng la mantsoe hore u a boloke mona.
s.p.voyage.not_ready: Ha e fetotsoe: phehamela ho tsoa marang-rang ka Internet.
s.p.voyage.show_hint: Bontša skrine ena ho motho ea ka pele ho uena.
s.p.voyage.hint: Tlhaloso ea sehlooho: Check important information (health, allergies, address).
s.p.learn.title: Ho ithuta
s.p.learn.start_title: U batla ho ithuta puo efe?

s.p.learn.all_done: Liithuti tsohle tsa lenane lena li phethetsoe. E ne e le hantle!
s.p.learn.m_learn_d: Liithuti ka tema, mantsoe a bohlokoa, lipoleloana
s.p.learn.m_ex_d: Lipotso tse potlakileng ka mantsoe a hau
s.p.learn.m_rev_d: Liphoso tsa hau le liithuti tse felileng
s.p.learn.local_note: Tšebelisano ea hau e bolokiloe ho sesebelisoa sena. Ho e etsa ka nako e le 'ngoe le ak'haonte ea hau ke mohato o latelang.
s.p.learn.bad: Ha ho joalo. Likarabo tse nepahetseng: {a}
s.p.learn.match_bad: E entsoe, le {n} error(s) ka tsela.
s.p.learn.score: {s} likarabo tse nepahetseng ho tsoa ho {t}
s.p.learn.res_try: Ho leka ka hohle ho u thusa ho tsoelapele. Tlanya hape ha u batla.
s.p.learn.rev_txt: Lipotso tse tsoang liphosong tsa hau le lingoloa tseo u li entseng.
s.p.learn.def_txt: Lipotso tse 8 ka mantsoe a tsoang boemong ba hau. U loketse?
s.p.learn.q_listen: Bala,'me u khetha seo u se bonang.
s.p.learn.reset: Ho hlakola nts'etsopele ea ka ho sesebelisoa sena
s.p.learn.ai_p1: Haholo-holo: ikopanye ka ho ngola le AI e tšepahalang, ka puo ea hau le boemo boo u bo khethileng, ka sehlooho (ho tsamaea, mosebetsi, bophelo ba letsatsi le letsatsi). Sehlooho se tla hlaha ka mor'a moo.
s.p.learn.ai_p2: Ke hobane'ng ha e se hona joale? AI ea puisano e hloka tšebeletso ea kantle. Lebitso la eona le lokela ho lula le bolokiloe server, ha ho na sebaka sa marang-rang. Ha ho na ntho e tla qala'me ha ho na tefo ntle le tumello ea hau.
s.p.learn.cult_p1: Kapele: linaha le libaka, litso, lipale, lihlooho le livideo, ho fumana lipuo.
s.p.learn.cult_p2: Sehlooho se hlophisitsoe joaloka lingoliloeng: faele e le 'ngoe ka moralo, e kenyelelitsoe ntle le ho fetola k'homphieutha.
s.p.learn.match_how: Tobetsa lentsoe, ebe u tobetsa ho fetolela.
s.p.learn.pair_bad: Ha e le hantle, ha ho joalo.

s.p.profil.title: Likarolo tsa puo
s.p.profil.sum_edit: Hlahloba profil ea ka ea puo
s.p.profil.sum_empty: Re bolella lipuo tsa hao: Lefatše le le leng le le leng,'me u utloisise hore na li sebetsa joang.
s.p.profil.sum_create: E-na le profil ea ka ea puo
s.p.profil.priv_synced: 🔒 Private: ka sesebelisoa sena le akhaonteng ea ka
s.p.profil.priv_contacts: 👥 Li-languages tse hlahang ho batho ba ikopanyang le nna
s.p.profil.pseudo_note: Lebitso la hau la ho sebelisana le batho ba bang ke lebitso la hau la Mehala (le hlophisitsoeng ka Mehala). Lebitso la ho bonts'a ha le hlokehe.
s.p.profil.name: E bonts'a lebitso
s.p.profil.level_hint: Sehloohong sena, re tla bua ka lihlopha tsa A1 ho ea ho C2.
s.p.profil.levels: A1 · Ba qalang (mantsoe, mantsoe a bonolo)|A2 · Elementary (mohlala oa letsatsi le letsatsi)|B1 · Motšehali (ho tsamaea, puisano e bonolo)|B2 · Upper intermediate (li-interlocutor tse utloahalang)|C1 · Advanced (ho fihlela ho tsohle)|C2 · Mastery (joalo ka motho ea nang le tsebo)
s.p.profil.max_spoken: E na le lipuo tse ka bang 12.
s.p.profil.already: Lentsoe lena le teng ka hare ho lenane.
s.p.profil.ui_note: Sehloohong sena ho na le lihlooho tse 31 (lihlooho tse 31 ka kakaretso).
s.p.profil.e_off: ak'haonte ha e fumanehe sebakeng sena
s.p.profil.fav_note: Ho na le lihlopha tse peli tsa pele (1-6) le tse tharo tsa bobeli (6-9).
s.p.profil.max_fav: 6 lihlooho tse ntle ka ho fetisisa.
s.p.profil.reading_note: Phahameng: lihlooho tse fokolang skrineng ha ho bua ka lehlakoreng le leng, le sebaka se eketsehileng. Tšoara: lihlooho tse ngata.
s.p.profil.prefer_note: "Typing" e bula keyboard ka kotloloho ho buisana ka lehlakoreng le leng.
s.p.profil.hands: Hands-free (mikrofono e ea ho motho e mong ka eona)
s.p.profil.sync_note: Ha ho na: profil ea hau e tla lula ka sesebelisoa sena. Ha ho na: e bolokiloe akhaonteng ea hau hore u ka e fumana ka lisebelisoa tse ling tsa hau. Ha ho motho ea ka e bala.
s.p.profil.sync_need: U hloka ak'haonte ea 24/24 ONE WORLD (lebitso la mosebelisi) ho boloka ak'haonte.
s.p.profil.vis: Ke mang ea bonang lipuo tsa ka
s.p.profil.vis_contacts: Li-contacts tsa ka (lenaneo la naha, lipuo tse boletsoeng le lebitso la ho bonts'a feela)
s.p.profil.vis_need_sync: Ho etsa hore batho ba u ikopanya le bona ba bone lipuo tsa hau, ho hlokahala hore pele o khethe “Tlohela akhaonteng ea ka”.
s.p.profil.never: Ha ho bonahale: imeile ea hau, lisebelisoa tsa hau, likhetho tsa hau, nts'etsopele ea Learn.
s.p.profil.cancel_note: Ha ho na ntho e bolokiloeng ho fihlela u tobetsa "Bokella".
s.p.profil.consent: Ke lumela hore profil ea ka ea puo e bolokiloe ho seva sa projeke (Supabase, European Union)'me ke tla e fumana hape libakeng tse ling tsa ka. Ke ka tlohela sena nako efe kapa efe ka ho koala sync: kopo ea seva e tla hlakoloa.
s.p.profil.consent_need: Khetha lebokose la tumello ho boloka akhaonteng ea hau, kapa o tlose ho hlophisoa ha nako e le 'ngoe.
s.p.profil.avatar_note: Avatar: li-initials tsa hau. Ha ho na setšoantšo se romelloang kapa se bolokiloe.
s.p.profil.saved_sync: E bolokiloe ho sesebelisoa sena le akhaonteng ea hau.
s.p.profil.sync_err: E bolokiloe ka sesebelisoa sena. Akaunti ea hau ha e khone ho nchafatsoa ({m}). Tseba hape ka mor'a moo.
s.p.profil.offline: Ha ho na marang-rang: e bolokiloe ka sesebelisoa sena feela. Tobetsa "Bokella" hape ha u kopane.
s.p.profil.loaded: Profile e fumaneha akhaonteng ea hau.
s.p.profil.erase: Ho tlosa profil ea ka ea puo
s.p.profil.erased_sync: Profile ea puo e hlakolotsoe ho tsoa ho sesebelisoa sena le akhaonteng ea hau.
